checks.assertion: Interactive states must be witnessed by actual input and replayable transitions. A visible native button or frame must match the exact observed tab control.
checks.observed: Real Chromium clicks, disclosure switching, autoplay and swipes produced distinct local evidence and editable state graphs. A changed signed transition graph was refused.
